user.title: Connect your Bigscreen
user.description: Enter the bridge address, for example {example}, and the pairing code shown on the TV (open Bridge Status from the launcher; press OK on its Pairing card for a new code). An existing bridge token also works.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new pairing code from the TV's Bridge Status screen (OK on its Pairing card), or a bridge token.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: A Bigscreen Bridge was found at {url}. Enter the pairing code shown on the TV in Bridge Status (for example 7KQ4-MXD2). An existing bridge token also works.

error.invalid_auth: The code is wrong or has expired, or the token was rejected
error.invalid_url: Enter an http(s) address without a path, query, or credentials
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different Bigscreen
error.too_many_attempts: Too many pairing attempts; wait a minute and try again

abort.not_supported: This bridge announces an unsupported protocol
